turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Patil from Delhi?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is he. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Sarah from Global Task Solutions. I saw your profile and wanted to offer you a simple part-time job where you just rate products online for easy money.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Rating products? I am retired, I do not know how to do such things.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is very simple, Mr. Patil. Just click a few buttons on your phone and you can earn three thousand rupees every day.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That sounds too much for such a small thing. How do I start?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You just need to activate your worker account first. Please transfer twelve thousand rupees as a refundable security deposit to this link I am sending.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Twelve thousand is a lot of money. Why should I pay to get a job?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is just for verification to show you are a serious worker. You will get it back with your first payment in two hours.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am very worried about this. Can you send me an official email first?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, the offer is only for today and the slots are filling fast. Just pay the fee now or you will lose this opportunity.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I do not think I can do this right now, let me ask my son.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not waste time talking to others. Just make the payment and I will double your balance immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I will call you back later then.
